skill.name: when-creating-skill-template-use-skill-builder
skill.description: Create Claude Code skill templates with YAML frontmatter, progressive disclosure, workflow documentation, and validation guidance.
skill.summary: Guide AI agents through creating structured Claude Code skill templates and supporting documentation.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, JavaScript template literals, checklist text, and identifiers such as phase.key. The meaningful risk is that the skill guides users to run npx claude-flow@alpha and other local commands, which requires explicit review and safer dependency handling.

remediation.suggestion: Pin claude-flow to a reviewed version and require explicit user confirmation before running npx commands.

remediation.issue: Generated shell command examples use variables
remediation.suggestion: Validate skill names and parameter values before placing them in shell commands.

remediation.issue: Generated bash script templates may include user-provided script bodies
remediation.suggestion: State that generated scripts must be reviewed before execution and avoid inserting unsafe script content automatically.

remediation.issue: Validation examples assume Unix tools and /dev/null
remediation.suggestion: Document platform prerequisites or provide a non-shell validation path for users without GraphViz or Unix devices.

semantic_findings.description: The skill repeatedly instructs users to run npx claude-flow@alpha commands. Running an unpinned alpha package can execute third-party code during skill generation and validation.

content.value_statement: Creating reusable AI skills requires consistent files and metadata. This skill guides Claude Code and Codex through a structured template workflow.
actual_capabilities: Defines required YAML frontmatter fields for skill metadata.
Guides a five-phase process for designing and documenting a skill.
Outlines SKILL.md, README.md, PROCESS.md, and process-diagram.gv files.
Includes validation steps for YAML, GraphViz, file completeness, and dry-run checks.
Shows integration patterns for claude-flow hooks and memory storage.
limitations: It is a template guide, not a standalone generator script.
Several examples rely on local claude-flow, GraphViz, and YAML tools.
Generated shell snippets require human review before execution.
It does not verify every marketplace policy for generated skills.

use_cases.title: Standardize New Skill Scaffolds
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable file structure and metadata checklist for new AI skills.

use_cases.title: Document Reusable Workflows
use_cases.description: Turn a workflow idea into skill documentation, process steps, and expected outputs.

use_cases.title: Review Skill Completeness
use_cases.description: Check whether a skill draft includes required files, validation steps, and usage guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner user creating a first skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Claude Code skill template for a workflow named [name]. Include purpose, triggers, required files, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Skill Phases
prompt_templates.scenario: User has an idea but needs structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design the phase structure for a skill that helps with [workflow]. Include objectives, agents, outputs, and success criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Workflow Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these workflow notes into a Claude Code skill package with SKILL.md, README.md, PROCESS.md, and a process diagram outline.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Generated Skill Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this generated skill draft for metadata completeness, progressive disclosure, validation coverage, command safety, and marketplace readiness.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a skill template for release note generation.
output: A SKILL.md outline with metadata, triggers, phases, and validation criteria.
A README.md quick start section for the release note workflow.
A PROCESS.md workflow summary and diagram plan.

output_examples.input: A user provides a workflow and asks for validation guidance.
output: A checklist for YAML validity, required files, documentation completeness, and dry-run behavior.
Warnings to review local commands before execution.
Suggested success metrics for the generated skill.

output_examples.input: A team wants a consistent structure for internal AI skills.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a reusable creation process with naming rules, metadata fields, file expectations, and review checkpoints.

best_practices: Review every generated command before running it locally.
Keep skill names, categories, triggers, and outputs specific to one workflow.
Validate generated files before adding the skill to a shared marketplace.
anti_patterns: Do not copy generated shell snippets into production without review.
Do not create broad skills that combine unrelated workflows.
Do not publish generated skills without checking metadata and documentation quality.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It guides creation of SKILL.md, README.md, PROCESS.md, and process-diagram.gv for a Claude Code skill.

faq.question: Is this a standalone command-line generator?
faq.answer: No. It is a skill guide that instructs an AI agent to produce structured skill files.

faq.question: Does it support Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace report marks it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Are the command examples safe to run automatically?
faq.answer: No. Users should review and approve local commands before execution.

faq.question: Can it convert an existing workflow into a skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for turning workflow notes into skill documentation and file structure.

faq.question: What should users verify before publishing?
faq.answer: Users should check YAML validity, required files, documentation completeness, and command safety.
